validation_envelope.name: Conservative Norfolk pilot coordinate-validation envelope
validation_envelope.provenance: Pre-registered from the documented Norfolk-only source inventory; this is a data-quality envelope, not a legal municipal boundary.

location_unit.rationale: Coordinates are available, but authoritative intersection topology is not. Fixed cells provide deterministic, complete pilot aggregation without claiming intersection identity.
location_unit.limitations: Cell boundaries are analytic proxies and are subject to the modifiable areal unit problem. They are not legal, roadway-engineering, or deployment units.
